items.source: Explicitly define the target type of the reference.
items.translation: 明确定义引用的目标类型。

items.source:
Explicitly define the target type of the reference. Used in case the annotated property is not the target type but
rather an identifier and/or if that identifier type is not uniquely identifying the target entity.
items.translation: 明确定义引用的目标类型。当注释的属性不是目标类型，而是标识符，或者该标识符类型无法唯一确定目标实体时，使用此选项。

items.source: Meta-annotation to be used to annotate annotations that mark references to other objects.
items.translation: 用于标注其他对象引用的元注释。
